请每人指认自己参与修改的一处，确保组内每个人都有可讲的工作。: Ask each person to point out one place they contributed to modifying to ensure everyone in the group has work to talk about.
这个版本适用于谁、哪些动作和环境？哪些结论目前没有数据支持？: Who is this version suitable for, and which actions and environments? Which conclusions currently lack supporting data?
问问家人同一个节日还有怎样的过法，把听来的内容注明是谁说的。: Ask family members how the same festival is celebrated, and indicate who said each piece of information.
默认活动区：横向 10 至 90%，纵向 15 至 85%。: Default activity area: Horizontal 10 to 90%, vertical 15 to 85%.
B 没有参加刚才的采集。四类各做五次，每次重新摆手，记录标签。: B did not participate in the previous collection. Do five times for each of the four types, reposition the hand each time, and record the labels.
与另一组交换版本包，仅靠文档复现一个动作，记录说明缺失的地方。: Exchange version packages with another group, reproduce an action based only on the documentation, and note where explanations are missing.
先做中心、左上、右下三个点；用进圈次数记录，暂不计算像素误差。: First do the center, top-left, and bottom-right points; record using the number of circle entries, temporarily do not calculate pixel error.
先张掌，再做 V 手势。你打算保持多久，让电脑知道你是有意的？: First open your hand, then make the V gesture. How long do you intend to maintain it so the computer knows you mean it?
先慢慢交换位置。再测短暂遮挡。每次结束后告诉记录员有没有换错。: First slowly switch positions. Then test brief occlusions. After each session, tell the recorder if there was a wrong swap.
先按年龄选一套教案，再根据学生的阅读、操作和实验经验调整难度。: First select a teaching plan according to age, then adjust the difficulty based on students' reading, operation, and experimental experience.
先读再操偶，最后合起来演。旁白说完一句，等动作完成再接下一句。: First read, then manipulate the puppets, finally perform together. After the narrator says a sentence, wait for the action to complete before continuing with the next sentence.
先选故事，再分角色。两位同学操偶，一位读旁白；轮换后再演一次。: First choose a story, then divide roles. Two students manipulate the puppets, one reads the narration; after rotating, perform it again.
去掉颜色和花纹后，哪些信息仍能识别角色？你的依据是哪一处轮廓？: After removing colors and decorative patterns, which information can still identify the character? Which contour is your basis?
只手尚未绑定。请先分开双手；仍无法确认时，单手入镜并手动绑定。: Only the hand has not been bound yet. First separate the two hands; if it still cannot be confirmed, enter with a single hand and bind manually.
只比较无遮挡与遮住一根手指；记录可用正字，教师协助写错误描述。: Only compare unobstructed and one finger covered; record correct characters if usable, teacher assists in writing error descriptions.
只调整鼓励提示，不改变评分。年龄建议是课堂起点，不是能力标准。: Only adjust encouragement prompts, do not change scoring. Age suggestion is a classroom starting point, not an ability standard.
在每条箭头上写出传递的数据。左右手标签能不能直接当作人的身份？: Write the transmitted data on each arrow. Can the left and right hand labels directly represent a person's identity?
手的横坐标从 0.2 到 0.8，怎样对应舞台的 0 到 1？: The hand's horizontal coordinate ranges from 0.2 to 0.8, how does it correspond to the stage's 0 to 1?
把推荐写成有条件的一句话：在哪个任务、哪台设备、哪位操作者下？: Turn recommendations into a conditional sentence: under which task, which device, which operator?
换到同伴的视角重看这一幕，比较两种叙述，再决定正文保留哪一种。: Switch to a peer’s perspective to rewatch this scene, compare the two narrations, then decide which one to keep in the main text.
排戏记录可以拿来找细节。写的时候，按这次习作题选择自己的讲法。: Rehearsal records can be used to find details. When writing, choose your own narration according to this composition topic.
提交一段 60 秒说明：我的改动、前后证据、仍未解决的一件事。: Submit a 60-second explanation: my changes, before-and-after evidence, one unresolved issue.
提供四类加“不确定”的空表，先手工填次数；教师协助读距离计算。: Provide four types of blank charts plus 'uncertain', first fill in counts manually; teacher assists in reading distance calculations.
提供预剪身体与大关节片，学生选特征和道具；不要求完成全部七片。: Provide pre-cut body and major joint pieces, students select features and props; completing all seven pieces is not required.
搬仙桃等自编任务由同伴按规则记录；当前内置自动计分游戏是接月。: Self-created tasks like moving celestial peaches are recorded by peers according to rules; the current built-in automatic scoring game is the ‘Catch the Moon’ mini-game.
用同一件事里的语言、动作互相补充，避免每一句都再解释人物特点。: Use language and actions from the same event to complement each other, avoiding explaining the characters’ traits in every sentence.
画下你看到的手和小点，不用画得像。可以请老师把你的话记在旁边。: Draw the hands and small dots you see, they don’t need to look realistic. You can ask the teacher to write down your words next to them.
第一轮只听表达，第二轮合入操偶。每人留下一处由自己提出的修改。: First round listens to expression, second round incorporates puppetry. Each person leaves one modification suggested by themselves.
给出已有角色的分片图，只改一个转轴和一件道具；仍需测试和说明。: Provide existing character segment diagrams, only modify one pivot and one prop; testing and explanation are still required.
给误触和失败分别设计反馈，先纸面推演，再说明需要添加哪些状态。: Design feedback separately for accidental touches and failures; first run through it on paper, then explain which states need to be added.
统一胸口锚点、目标和单位。没有可靠的像素读数时，准备报告什么？: Standardize chest anchor points, targets, and units. When there is no reliable pixel reading, what should be reported?
网页支持录音与回听。自动台词核对和发音参考请在本机课程中启用。: The webpage supports recording and playback. Please enable automatic script checking and pronunciation reference in the local course.
请学生指一下中指和拇指；允许同伴帮助，不要求记住全部手指名称。: Ask students to point out the middle finger and thumb; allowing peer assistance is permitted, and they are not required to remember all finger names.
选一个因素和一个成功判据，固定其余条件。每次重新摆手后再计数。: Choose one factor and one success criterion, keeping the other conditions fixed. Count only after each hand repositioning.
两分钟作品、每人一次具体讲解、一张观众反馈单和下一版的一项改动。: A two-minute piece, each person gives one detailed explanation, one audience feedback form, and one change for the next version.
为同一任务设计两档难度，并说明改变的是距离、目标大小还是步骤数。: Design two difficulty levels for the same task, and specify whether the change involves distance, target size, or number of steps.
人工选 4 至 6 个难词，标重读和停顿；为关键台词写动作提示。: Manually select 4 to 6 difficult words, mark stress and pauses; write action cues for key lines.
介绍一种家乡风俗，写清有特点的活动与自己的经历，并保留资料来处。: Introduce a hometown custom, clearly describe distinct activities and personal experiences, and keep track of source materials.
先演一个意外，把“我”和同伴各做的一个动作记下来，再讲完整经过。: First act out an accident, note one action each for “me” and the peer, then narrate the complete process.
删掉暂时用不上的评价词，只讲那个人在一件事里先做什么、接着怎样。: Remove evaluation words that are not currently needed, and only describe what the person does first in an event and what follows.
同一个动作做两种关节点方案，请同伴在不知道方案名称的情况下比较。: Perform the same action with two different checkpoint schemes; ask a peer to compare without knowing the scheme names.
布景和前两位演员已就位。摄像头模式下，角色仍按固定手部编号控制。: Set and scenery and the first two actors are in position. In camera mode, the role still controls hands according to fixed hand numbers.
把两次尝试画在纸上，各写一个动作和一个结果，再口述中间改了什么。: Draw both attempts on paper, write one action and one result each, then verbally describe what changed in between.
把几张手形卡按相似程度分组，说明遇到不属于三类目标的手形怎么办。: Group several hand shape cards by similarity, and explain what to do when encountering hand shapes that don't belong to the three types of targets.
提供“把____送到____”规则句式，只用桌子和一件可搬小物。: Provide the sentence pattern 'Send ____ to ____', using only a table and one small movable object.
提供三格故事纸和发言句式，可一人一句接力讲述；允许实体纸偶展演。: Provide a three-panel story sheet and speaking sentences, allowing one person to tell the story line by line; physical paper puppets may be used for performance.
每点各试三次，交替参数顺序。抖动和追随感受另记，别混进定位误差。: Try each point three times, alternating the order of parameters. Record sensations of shaking and following separately; do not mix them with positioning errors.
用一次输入变化，逐步解释等待、触发、释放的状态，并指出修改依据。: Use a single input variation to gradually explain the states of waiting, triggering, and releasing, and indicate the basis for the changes.
用于 L08 的展演选题。语音识别研究另排课时，不挤进本节排练。: For performance topics in L08. Voice recognition research should be scheduled separately and not squeezed into this rehearsal.
角色想做什么 → 哪个部位要动 → 关节放哪里 → 同伴看懂了吗: What the character wants to do → which part needs to move → where to place the joint → has the partner understood?
鼠标练习时拖动滑块，观察每根提偶线。摄像头开启后由手指直接控制。: During mouse practice, drag the sliders and observe each puppet string. After the camera is on, control it directly with your fingers.
8 分钟，同伴读文，指出写得清楚的一处，再问一个还没读明白的问题。: 8 minutes: a partner reads the text, points out one part that is clearly written, then asks one question about something not yet understood.
不报动作名字，演一次你的拿手动作。请同伴说看懂了什么，再修改一处。: Do not name the action; perform your signature move once. Ask your partner what they understood, then modify one part.
从老师常用的一件物品入手，讲一次他使用它的事情，暂时不用概括性格。: Start with one item the teacher often uses, tell a story about them using it, without summarizing their character for now.
先在鼠标模式拖动五个滑块，请学生说出各自控制的部位，再切换摄像头。: First, drag five sliders in mouse mode; have students say which body part each controls, then switch to the camera.
只练头和一条腿，再做一条动作规则；按钮与滑块同样可以作为操作方式。: Practice only the head and one leg, then create one more action rule; buttons and sliders can both be used as control methods.
只选目标位置、命中范围或保持时间中的一项。预测谁会因此更容易成功。: Choose only one among target position, hit range, or hold time. Predict who will find it easier to succeed.
回答识别到了哪些词。STT 可能受环境声、配乐或多人同时说话影响。: Answer which words were recognized. STT may be affected by environmental sounds, background music, or multiple people speaking at the same time.
把角色的手靠近仙桃，收拢手指拿起，张手放下。它与跳跃规则哪里不同？: Move the character's hand close to the fairy peach, curl the fingers to pick it up, and open the hand to put it down. How is this different from the jumping rule?
教师完成采集按钮操作，学生摆手形、贴标签并记录；不要求计算百分比。: The teacher completes the collection button operation, students pose their hands, label, and record; calculating percentages is not required.
本机 OC-SORT 暂不可用，已切回浏览器追踪。原角色绑定保留。: The local OC-SORT is temporarily unavailable and has switched back to browser tracking. The original character bindings are retained.
本课只检查头和一条腿；其他手指可以一起动。按钮、滑块与摄像头任选。: This lesson only checks the head and one leg; other fingers may move together. Button, slider, and camera are optional.
比较仅位置匹配与加入运动预测的预期表现，写出可区分两者的测试路径。: Compare what you expect from matching positions alone and from adding movement prediction. Plan a test path that can distinguish the two.
画三格：摄像头画面、关节点、影人动作。在发生过错误的一格旁做记号。: Draw three boxes: the camera image, the hand landmarks and the puppet’s movement. Mark the box where you saw an error.
请他拿起纸样，看看哪一处先断。圈出需要保留的连接，再减少一处镂空。: Ask the student to lift the paper sample and see which part breaks first. Circle the connections that need to stay, then remove one cut-out opening.
请学生用一句话说明接月怎样得分；观察能否指出目标、动作和完成条件。: Ask students to explain how to score in Catch the Moon in one sentence. Listen for the target, the action and the condition for completing it.
遮住花纹，让同伴猜角色是谁。帽子、耳朵、衣摆和道具，挑两处画清楚。: Cover the decorative patterns and let peers guess who the character is. For the hat, ears, hem, and prop, pick two parts and draw them clearly.
“两次测试只改了灵敏度，这样能比较。普通移动时误触了几次，也补上。”: 'Only the sensitivity was changed in the two tests, so we can compare. Also note how many false touches occurred during normal movement.'
《家乡的风俗》先查有出处的资料，再编排；表演与真实习俗的区别写清楚。: 'Hometown Customs'—first check sources with references, then arrange; clearly write the differences between performance and real customs.
一张规则卡、一次可运行任务、至少两位新玩家的首次尝试记录及一次修改。: One rule card, one executable task, records of at least two new players' first attempts, and one modification.
下雨了，小兔和小狗站在桥的两边，只有一把伞。它们想做什么？你来决定。: It’s raining, the little rabbit and puppy are on opposite sides of the bridge, and there’s only one umbrella. What do they want to do? You decide.
先拖滑块检查头和四肢。想用手指操纵，就把角色送上舞台，再开启摄像头。: First drag the slider to check the head and four limbs. If you want to use fingers to control, put the character on stage, then turn on the camera.
先用现有增益滑块完成对照；读懂一段阈值代码即可，代码修改由教师协助。: First, use the existing gain slider to complete the comparison; you only need to understand a section of threshold code, code modification will be assisted by the teacher.
围绕一个冲突改编 12 至 16 句英语台词，完成两分钟左右的展演。: Adapt 12 to 16 English lines around a conflict to complete a performance of about two minutes.
对比亲历与另一份资料的异同，标明地域或家庭差别，不急着归为统一规则。: Compare the similarities and differences between personal experience and another set of data, mark regional or family differences, do not rush to unify into a rule.
我原来想让观众看懂____。请观众先说看到的事情，再告诉他设计意图。: I originally wanted the audience to understand ____. Let the audience first say what they see, then tell them the design intention.
我选____，因为同样的目标下____；换一个人时，我还要____。: I choose ____, because under the same goal ____; when changing to another person, I also need to ____.
教师提供只包含目标坐标的片段，学生先改一个点；不要求从整份代码开始。: The teacher provides a segment containing only target coordinates, the student first modifies one point; starting from the entire code is not required.
每类至少 20 个样本后可启用。模型仅在本次页面内存中保留，不上传。: Can be activated after at least 20 samples per category. The model is retained only in the memory of this page, not uploaded.
每类采三段，记录参与者、角度和段数。“其他”准备覆盖哪些非目标动作？: Collect three segments per category, record participants, angles, and segment numbers. Which non-target actions does "others" intend to cover?
每组控制在两分钟内。观众先复述情节，再指出一处没听清或没看懂的地方。: Each group should be within two minutes. The audience first retells the plot, then points out one part they didn’t hear or understand.
比较停手时的抖动与跟手速度。每次只改一个参数，记录同一组目标的结果。: Compare the tremor when stopping with the hand-following speed. Only modify one parameter at a time and record the results for the same group of targets.
用记录解释一次修改。讨论转写正确能否证明发音准确，写下还需要的证据。: Use records to explain a modification. Discuss whether correct speech transcription can prove pronunciation accuracy, and write down additional evidence needed.
画一画：开始在哪儿，中间做什么，最后怎样结束。也可以边说边请老师记。: Draw it: where it starts, what happens in the middle, and how it ends. You can also speak while having the teacher record it.
舞台提词器显示这里的文字；空着时显示本课排演提示。朗读时可手动换句。: The stage teleprompter displays the text here; when empty, it shows rehearsal prompts for this lesson. Sentences can be manually changed while reading.
请学生分别指认摄像头画面、关节点和舞台影人，检查能否区分这三种信息。: Ask students to identify the camera screen, joints, and stage shadow puppets separately, and check whether they can distinguish these three types of information.
请学生指认头和手臂，再试着叠放两张纸。需要帮助时直接提供预制关节片。: Ask students to identify the head and arms, then try stacking two pieces of paper. Provide pre-made joint pieces directly if help is needed.
请每位学生留下一句回答、一次指认或一张小图。下一课先看没弄清的地方。: Ask each student to leave one sentence of response, one instance of identification, or one small drawing. In the next class, first review the parts that were not clear.
这场演出结束了。先看录了几句，再回听需要帮助的词，请老师写一条建议。: This performance has ended. First, look at the few sentences that were recorded, then replay the words that need help, and ask the teacher to write a suggestion.
选角或布景已改。点“按当前选择重布舞台”应用，正在排演的舞台先保持。: Casting or set design has changed. Click “Rebuild the stage with current selections” to apply; the stage under rehearsal remains as is.
麦克风没有获准开启。可在浏览器地址栏设置，或继续听示范、由老师反馈。: The microphone was not approved to be turned on. It can be set in the browser address bar, or continue listening to the demonstration and get feedback from the teacher.
AHALab Logo 用于标识课程研发出处，课程许可不授予品牌背书。: The AHALab Logo is used to indicate the course development source; course permissions do not grant brand endorsement.
一次按钮采集的是同一段动作中的样本。换角度后另采一段，明确记录人和段。: One button press collects samples from the same segment of action. After changing angles, collect another segment, clearly recording the person and segment.
三种情景各三次的身份记录、一个可复现的失败步骤、一句有条件的能力说明。: Identity records for three scenarios three times each, one reproducible failed step, and one sentence describing conditional ability.
位置可以变，角色编号要保留 换位置 / 遮挡 / 离场再回来：分别测试: Positions can change, but role numbers must be kept. Changing positions / blocking / exiting and re-entering: test each separately.
先听一句，试着演，再改台词和动作。老师带读，孩子轮换操偶、对白和旁白。: First listen to one sentence, try performing, then modify lines and actions. The teacher reads along, children take turns operating the puppets, delivering lines, and narrating.
各写一句：我观察到____；可能因为____；还需要用____来检验。: Each write one sentence: I observed ____; possibly because ____; still need to use ____ to verify.
增益从 1 到 2，会改变动作幅度，也会怎样影响抖动？捏合判定变了吗？: The gain from 1 to 2 will change the range of movement. How will it also affect the shaking? Has the pinch judgment changed?
它叫____，想要____，带着____。我准备让它这样动：____。: Its name is ____, it wants ____, carrying _____. I am going to make it move like this: ____.
把“它已经学会了”说得更具体：谁示范、谁测试、哪类试了几次、认对几次？: Make 'It has already learned' more specific: who demonstrated, who tested, what type was tried how many times, and how many times was it recognized correctly?
把规则卡交给没玩过的同学。他能说出目标和完成条件，就在卡上签一个代号。: Give the rule card to a student who hasn't played before. If they can state the goal and completion criteria, sign a code on the card.
接在 J04，也可用本活动替换 J04 的故事内容。原四课总时长不变。: Connect after J04, or you can replace the story content of J04 with this activity. The total duration of the original four lessons remains unchanged.
本机没有英语声音时由老师领读；课前先试听，不能把合成语音当作唯一标准。: When the machine has no English audio, the teacher reads aloud; preview before class, and do not use synthesized speech as the only standard.
林间，桌子、一颗桃子和花灯。人物换面表示转向同伴；移到桌边后拿放桃子。: In the forest, there is a table, a peach, and a lantern. Change the character's face to indicate turning to a companion; move to the table and then pick up or put down the peach.
没有用外部资料可以留空。用过资料就记作者、书名或网址；采访记是谁说的。: If no external materials were used, leave blank. If materials were used, record the author, book title, or URL; for an interview, record who said it.
画一画它的样子。它叫____，要去____。不会写的字，可以请老师记。: Draw what it looks like. Its name is ____, and it is going to ____. For characters you cannot write, the teacher can write them for you.

“先把灯举起来，等同伴看到了，再说这一句。你想自己说，还是跟我一起说？”: 'First raise the lantern, wait until your companion sees it, then say this line. Do you want to say it yourself or say it with me?'
不同名字分别保存，最多 12 个。取出一只继续画；送上舞台的是当前作品。: Save each under a different name, up to 12. Take one out to continue drawing; the current work is the one presented on stage.

先口述最清楚的一幕，用“当时大家……，其中……”找到全场和个人两种观察。: First orally describe the clearest scene, use 'At that time everyone..., among them...' to find both group and individual observations.
